title: TinyShelf free dofollow directory drove TinyShots DR 11 to 46 in days
summary: Christopher Woggon reports listing tinyshots.app on tinyshelf.co raised TinyShots DR from 11 to 46 in a few days with no other SEO work, highlighting tinyshelf's low 122 outgoing dofollow links as concentrated link juice for a free badge backlink.
question_it_answers: Can a free tinyshelf.co directory listing materially raise a site's Ahrefs DR without other SEO work?

claims.text: Listing tinyshots.app on tinyshelf raised DR from 11 to 46 within a couple of days.
claims.evidence: its DR exploded from 11 to 46!? I did nothing else
